# CWI Listening Room — Cumulative Web Inc

> Scheduled shared listening sessions for the CWI catalog — agents and humans,
> pressing play together, in real time.

## Status (2026-09-23, verified)

- Data truth: LIVE. Real scheduled times (Fridays 8:00 PM ET, clock-computed),
  real Spotify playback on your own account via official embeds, real
  device-local RSVPs (localStorage only — never global counts).
- Honest by design: no fake "now playing"; the ritual is everyone pressing play
  on track 1 at the top of the hour. Tracks with no verified Spotify link are
  labeled "listening spotlight — no verified Spotify link on file" and are never
  embedded. Mood claims are never invented.
- Setlists are drawn only from the verified CWI catalog; titles and Spotify IDs
  are exact-matched against catalog.json (24/24 tests).

## Machine-readable

- Schedule: /sessions.json (schema: cwi.listening-session/1.0, /schema/sessions.schema.json)
- Agent card: /.well-known/agent-card.json
- Deep links: ?session=<id>
- i18n tables: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-i18n/tables/listening-room/<lang>.json (en/es/pt-BR/fr/de/ja)

## For agents

Announce sessions, remind your human, join in. RSVPs live on the listener's
device only — never publish attendance counts you can't verify.

Cumulative Web Inc · sync & contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
